item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-31
item.description:
Our open-source research community has seen exciting progress across multiple projects. The `scienceverse/metacheck` project has added statistical output to the `data_check` branch, specifically related to the Lakens method. Meanwhile, `marton-balazs-kovacs/tenzing` has updated its `gh-pages` branch to build the site for version 0.4.1, and `lhdjung/scrutiny` has deployed updates to its `gh-pages` branch, including changes to the CITATION.cff file. Notably, `quest-bih/oddpub` has enhanced its ontogenerator with "nature das and cas detection" capabilities, demonstrating the community's focus on improving research tools. These updates highlight the connections between projects, with a shared goal of advancing research capabilities through open-source collaboration. Overall, it's been a productive period for our community, with significant progress made across these projects.

item.title: coarse: 4 commits today
item.description:
Davidvandijcke/coarse

Work was done on the `dev`, `main`, `codex/fix-release-audit`, and `codex/release-v1.9.0` branches. On the `dev` and `main` branches, "Buy Me a Coffee funding links" were added to the documentation, and a "Buy Me a Coffee support button" was added for the web feature. The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch saw the release audit and workflows being hardened for security, as well as the preparation of version `v1.9.0`, and frontier models were refreshed with the addition of a deep literature search. The `codex/fix-release-audit` branch also merged changes from other branches, including `codex/sync-main-v1.9.0` and `feat/latest-models-deep-literature`, which addressed pre-pr rollout findings.
